items.example: What's your plan for the weekend?

items.en: I'm going to + verb: I'm going to visit my parents.
items.example: I'm going to visit my parents on Sunday.
items.exampleTr: Pazar günü annemle babamı ziyaret edeceğim.
items.note: Önceden karar verdiğin planlar için kullanılır.

items.example: Maybe we can meet on Saturday.
I'll probably stay at home tonight.
items.exampleTr: Bu akşam büyük ihtimalle evde kalacağım.

items.en: I'll + verb: I'll call you later.
items.example: I'll call you later, okay?
items.note: Anlık karar veya söz verirken 'will' kullanılır.

items.example: Are you free on Friday evening?
items.note: Bir şey önermeden önce sorulan çok doğal bir soru.

items.example: I'm not available on Monday.

items.en: I'm thinking of + -ing: I'm thinking of moving.
items.example: I'm thinking of changing my job.
We need to decide by tomorrow.
I haven't decided yet. I'll tell you tomorrow.
I'll definitely come to your party.
Can you arrange a meeting for Tuesday?
items.exampleTr: Salı için bir toplantı ayarlayabilir misin?

items.en: What are you up to this weekend?
items.example: What are you up to this weekend?
items.note: Gündelik konuşmada 'planın ne?' demenin rahat yolu.

items.en: I'm meeting + person: I'm meeting a friend tonight.
items.example: I'm meeting a friend for lunch tomorrow.
items.exampleTr: Yarın öğle yemeğinde bir arkadaşımla buluşuyorum.

items.example: I hope it doesn't rain on Saturday.

items.en: I might + verb: I might go out later.
items.example: I might go out later, but I'm not sure.
items.exampleTr: Belki sonra çıkarım ama emin değilim.
items.note: 'will'den daha belirsiz, yarı yarıya bir ihtimal.

items.example: My schedule is really full this week.
It depends on the weather.
Let's postpone the trip until next month.
I had to cancel our dinner plans.
items.exampleTr: Akşam yemeği planımızı iptal etmek zorunda kaldım.

items.example: I don't know yet. Let's see how it goes.
I'll let you know by tonight.
items.exampleTr: Bu akşama kadar sana haber veririm.

items.example: What are your plans for the future?
